Strawberry Marzipan
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 23, 2009 - 12:07am

Ingredients




3 pkg. strawberry Jello
1 can condensed milk
2 tablespoons sugar
3/4 pound coconut, chopped fine
1 teaspoon almond extract
10 drops red food coloring

Preparation

1 Mix together all ingredients except 1 package of Jello. Set aside at room temperature for 3 hours. Roll into the shape of strawberries. Roll in extra Jello. Prick each with a fork for seed effect. Put green frosting hulls on top; with toothpick for stem. When done, store in refrigerator, covered. For oranges, use orange Jello, roll in balls and put clove in for stem.
